findings.title: Mode-status failure claims high-performance is on
findings.repro: Connect saved Mac hp.on=true; return HTTP500/non-JSON from /api/mode/:id. After connect toolbar title is 고성능 모드 켜짐 — 누르면 끕니다; hp-quality control count is 0. catch is empty, hpFallback null, hpActual false.
findings.impact: Cannot distinguish the saved preference from verified active transport; diagnostics and fallback recovery are misleading when status lookup fails.
findings.fix: Represent mode as checking/active/fallback/unknown. On fetch/parse failure display 확인하지 못함 with retry; only claim active after hp===true.

findings.title: Background failure tells user to reopen but erases the failure
findings.repro: Prepare and apply; choose 백그라운드에서 계속; inject error 앱 설치는 완료됐지만 설정 공유에 실패했습니다: fixture vault failure. Toast says reopen to inspect. Reopen: data-error text empty/hidden and data-form visible. current=null discards exact failure and partial-success state.
findings.impact: Admin cannot know whether app was installed, settings were imported or recovery is needed; repeating install may be unnecessary.
findings.fix: Retain completed/failed operation and exact stage/error/result for reattach; provide dismiss/retry action and clear distinction between app install and settings import.

findings.title: Confirmation hides exact connection/account scope behind counts
findings.repro: All profiles start selected; advance to confirmation. Review only says N개 연결 · M개 계정, not the selected names, addresses or identities. Original form is hidden.
findings.impact: For family/work address books, admin must backtrack to verify whose profiles and credentials they are about to share. Counts are inadequate for deliberate secret sharing.
findings.fix: Include selected connection names/addresses and referenced account names in the confirmed plan; show which accounts have passwords/keys included, never secret values; add select-all/none for long lists.

findings.title: Unknown capture status looks like ordinary fast-mode quality action
findings.repro: With hpActual true and saved native=false, inject matching status quality=points, quality_active=false, capture dimensions zero. Label is generic 선명하게 (Retina) — 글자가 또렷해지고 프레임은 조금 줄어듭니다; no unknown/checking indication. After bounded retries an unknown state has no explicit recovery.
findings.impact: Worker cannot tell if current fast mode was verified or status is unavailable. Does not reintroduce the old saved-preference-as-active native bug: real valid active reports are handled correctly.
findings.fix: Show checking then 확인하지 못함 with retry when capture inactive/zero or responses exhausted, regardless of saved native choice.

findings.title: First-time SSH install recovery sends user to another journey without direct action
findings.repro: New host has no trusted key; prepare refuses with instruction to use file-open or SSH screen connection. Setup has only generic error/back controls, no verify-host navigation preserving target/account/selection.
findings.impact: Admin provisioning a new device must leave setup, find another feature and reconstruct context; strict trust behavior is correct but recovery adds avoidable setup friction.
findings.fix: Offer Verify SSH host action using existing trust-confirmation flow then return to setup with target/account and selection preserved; keep strict no-auto-accept policy.

src/remote_setup.rs:31-76 copies explicit preference allowlist, preserving remote startup/web exposure by exclusion; web/remote-setup.js:22 explains nonshared permission/web/trust settings.
